versions.subject: CrackMapExec patterns
versions.detection:
selection_lsass_dump1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'cmd.exe /c '
        - 'tasklist /fi '
        - 'Imagename eq lsass.exe'
    User|contains: 
        - 'NT AUTHO'
        - 'NT AUTO'
selection_lsass_dump2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'do rundll32.exe C:\windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
        - ' full'
        - '%%B'
selection_procdump:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'tasklist /v /fo csv' 
        - 'findstr /i "lsass"'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*cmd.exe /c *" CommandLine="*tasklist /fi *" CommandLine="*Imagename eq lsass.exe*" User IN ("*NT AUTHO*", "*NT AUTO*")) OR (CommandLine="*do rundll32.exe C:\\windows\\System32\\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump*" CommandLine="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" CommandLine="* full*" CommandLine="*%%B*") OR (CommandLine="*tasklist /v /fo csv*" CommandLine="*findstr /i \"lsass\"*")
